item.title: US designates American held in China as wrongfully detained ahead of Xi's White House visit
item.description: The Trump administration has officially labeled Min Zin as wrongfully detained in China, just weeks before President Trump is scheduled to welcome President Xi Jinping to the White House.

item.title: Atlanta mayor criticizes DNC in letter for neglecting Black voters after convention snub
item.description: In a scathing letter to national party leadership, Atlanta's mayor accused the DNC of abandoning the South and Black voters after the city was excluded from hosting the convention.

item.title: Oregon State University introduces required courses on disrupting US 'systems of repression'
US imposes new sanctions on Hezbollah, highlighting ties to Iran
item.description: The United States is set to issue new sanctions against Hezbollah on Thursday, including re-designating the group under a terrorism authority, according to reports.
